name: Waiting for an ambulance, then a fall
description: Dennis has a severe chest infection; the GP sends him in and an ambulance is called at 11:45. He falls (serious) at 11:58 before it comes. The fall resets the ambulance task to open, so the crew walk to his bedside for a task that never runs again and never reach the fall: Dennis stays on the floor indefinitely, his carer stays past the end of her shift, and his doses are skipped with nothing recorded.
